slots.NO_ALIGNMENT_LINE: - Do NOT output any alignment, reference, or "aligns with" line. Begin your reply directly with "integrated_multimodal_description:".
slots.NO_PREAMBLE_LINE: - No preamble, no explanation, no markdown fences, no extra fields.
slots.SPEAKER_ORDER_LINE: - Speaker IDs follow the order voices are FIRST HEARD. The first character to speak is (S1) even if another character is the one shown in <Picture 1>.
slots.STYLE_SOURCE_LINE: - The visual style comes from <Picture 1> (see REFERENCE IMAGE). Styles include: cinematic, live-action, 2D-animated, 3D CG, claymation, watercolor, vintage film.
slots.WHOLE_LINE_RULE: - Keep every spoken line whole inside ONE shot; never split a <d> block across a cut and never write an empty or nearly-empty <d> block. If a line begins in one shot and finishes after a cut, place the ENTIRE line in the first shot's <d> block and note that the audio continues over the cut. Reserve <cutoff> only for a line truncated by the video's end.
